workers.title: Route OpenAI executor job directory and output through rooted exclusive writer
workers.done_when: invokeOpenAI never creates .woody/jobs through unbounded os.MkdirAll or writes the canonical output through unrooted os.WriteFile. It calls ensureOwnedJobsDir(c.Root) before startJobReceipt and writeOwnedJobOutput(c.Root, outputPath, data) for output; any publication error is recorded as runner_error and no model DONE/PASS. Preserve RequestStarted, provider vendor_limit classification, native receipt lock/refusal and transport semantics. No other source files changed.
workers.instructions: ONLY EDIT cmd/runner_openai.go. Before startJobReceipt, replace os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(receiptPath),0755) with `ensureOwnedJobsDir(c.Root)`; remove unused imports as needed. workers.title: Route router executor job output through rooted writer and propagate failure

workers.instructions: ONLY EDIT cmd/runner_router.go.
